statement: Every committed capture, the script that made it, what a reviewer concluded about it, and the checks that keep the claim honest: the index agrees with the disk, the theme in the filename is the theme in the pixels, the producer still exists, and a set that was re-shot in this story says so. A set nobody reviewed is a finding.

sets.note: Refusal states rather than panes: the 403 a read-only session's apply earns, drawn inside the diff dialog that stays open, the injected 503, the rate-limited Chat send, and the same refused apply at 390x740 — in both themes, plus the pre-story `Applied!` toast for contrast. Every frame names the state it is in; none of them can be mistaken for a success.
The composer's stop, failure and handoff states, including the restored draft after a refused send; the transcript stays readable while the refusal is drawn above it.

Chat's conversation column: six shots on each of four viewports x light/dark - empty, populated, long-content, loading, error and recovery - written by `scripts/chat_layout_walk.mjs` against fixtures it starts itself (default, `--slow-model` for the reply in progress, `--long-model` for the reply long enough to scroll, and the catalogue's keyless provider row for the failure), after 26/26 checks on each of the eight runs, beside `before-uiv2-18/`, the empty and populated states served from origin/main at 21c1eef captured by this walk in `--capture-only`. Opened and read: the 1440x900-dark populated capture (an 820px column centred in the 1,240px pane, the answer at the column's width, the question aligned to its right edge, the composer under both), the 1440x900-dark long-content capture (a code block with its own scrollbar inside its bubble and an unbroken token that wraps instead of widening the pane), the 390x844-light populated capture (a three-row control bar and the same column at phone width), and the before-uiv2-18 1640x900-light populated capture (an 870px answer in a 1,300px row, a full-width composer, and the second control row).
sets.theme_claim: light and dark, desktop 1280-1640 and narrow 390

sets.note: Chat's persona picker: six shots on each of four viewports x light/dark - empty, populated, long-content, loading, error and recovery - written by `scripts/chat_persona_walk.mjs` against fixtures it starts itself, after 21/21 checks on each of the eight runs, beside `before-uiv2-19/`, the empty and populated states served from origin/main at 3bd4890 and captured by this same walk in `--capture-only` (3/17 checks there: the registry, the filter and the description line are the things the story adds, so their absence is what the before set is). Opened and read: the 1440x900-dark empty capture (the picker with its filter beside it and one clamped description line under both, inside the same one-row control bar UIV2-18 measured), the 390x844-light empty capture (the same three parts at phone width, the bar still three rows), and the before-uiv2-19 1440x900-dark empty capture (the select alone, its value a paragraph of prose, nothing describing it).
sets.theme_claim: light and dark, desktop 1024-1440 and narrow 390

sets.note: Chat's streaming, tool disclosure, copy and recovery: six shots on each of four viewports x light/dark - empty, populated, long-content, loading, error and recovery - written by `scripts/chat_recovery_walk.mjs` against fixtures it starts itself, after 25/25 checks on each of the eight runs, beside `before-uiv2-20/`, the empty and populated states served from origin/main at 2b0c35f and captured by this same walk in `--capture-only` (7/14 there). Opened and read: the 1440x900-dark populated capture (a fenced code block with its labelled Copy control, one tool disclosure open under its Failed status word with the arguments and the 500-character cap, and the turn's '1 tool call - 1 failed - 1 ms' line), the 1440x900-dark loading capture (a stopped turn reading 'Stopped by you - N characters kept in this pane'), and the before-uiv2-20 1440x900-dark populated capture (the same reply with a bare Copy button and no tool call, because the old fixture could not make one).
sets.theme_claim: light and dark, desktop 1024-1440 and narrow 390

sets.note: The Compare pane's question-first composition: 4 states x 4 viewports x light/dark plus the 390x844 stack, written by `scripts/compare_balanced_walk.mjs` against `council_readiness_seed.py` with two local models that answer, after 17/17 checks on each of the eight runs, and beside it `before-uiv2-16/`, the same pane from origin/main at 5c9a6e3 captured with `capture_screenshots.mjs --panes debate`. Opened and read: the 1440x900-light pair (before: the fold holds the four-row criteria table and the question is under it; after: the question and the two picks fill the fold and the criteria are one folded line reading '3 settled by the run · 1 not settled here · 2 yours to judge'), the 1440x900-dark two-model capture (two 434x229 answers at the same width and height, the results table under them, Result columns 2 in the inspector), the 1440x900-dark criteria-open capture (three groups on their own emerald/amber/cyan rails), and the 390x844-light one-model capture (the single-answer note above one full-width card, nothing overflowing).

sets.note: The record bar keeps a finished comparison readable while the reader starts another.
The criteria table names what settles each criterion and says `you` where the pane cannot decide — the same table the refreshed published Compare capture now shows.

The Compare pane's results, verdict and evidence rail: nine shots on each of four viewports x light/dark - seven states, the 390x844 narrow shot and the rail on its own - written by `scripts/compare_evidence_walk.mjs` against fixtures it starts itself (default, `--slow-model`, `--long-model`, and the catalogue's keyless provider row for the failure), after 25/25 checks on each of the eight runs, beside `before-uiv2-17/`, the same two states served from origin/main at faff1e9 captured by an earlier copy of the walk in `--capture-only`. Opened and read: the 1440x900-dark populated capture (two 434px answers, one row each in both tables, the rail reading `Panels 2 of 2 answered` and one evidence line per reply), the 1440x900-dark verdict capture (arbiter named with its catalogue row, `The replies above are its evidence`, and its own 41.2 tok/s badge), the 1440x900-dark error capture (a dash where the size would be and `the provider failed before it reported any figure` where a figure would be), the 390x844-light narrow capture (both tables stacked with their labels and no sideways scroll), and the before-uiv2-17 1440x900-light populated capture (`0 ch` for the failed row, a verdict with no provenance, and a rail that points at the pane).
sets.theme_claim: light and dark, desktop 1280-1640 and narrow 390

sets.note: Each reply carries the model, locality and cost it was produced with.
The deliberation stages are shown in order, with the seat that is speaking marked.
Four pre-round seats with exact model ids, locality and readiness, and the shared-memory disclosure; a seat that is not ready says why instead of looking idle.
The verdict card states the winner, the tally and the seats that dissented.
Task creation, workspace and run settings with the diff, approval and abort controls still reachable.

The verification-and-artifacts surface, re-taken from the fixed build: `rejected-card` and `rejected-record` show the rejected completion (#169, closed) with the code that decided it, the exit code and the failing test classified as introduced.
The four approval states, including the session-scoped refusal the server enforces.
The seven recovery states of a Harness run: each carries the server's reason, what was kept and the action that moves it, and none of them reuses the ok tone.

The durable log and the cursor discipline, re-taken from the fixed build: `pruned` shows the strip saying 9 events held over the retained floor seq 5-13 (#170, closed), and `replayed` the window a resync draws after the whole log is re-read.
Tab order and focus rings on the shell's own controls; the ring is the same 2px in both themes.

The MCP hub: its catalog, its connected-server dashboard and its activity log - eleven shots on each of four viewports x light/dark (catalog, search, connected, a server that could not be reached, a stored token, activity, a slow call's loading state, a long output, a failed call, the health list and the keyboard state), written by `scripts/mcp_hub_walk.mjs` against a fixture it starts itself and a real stdio MCP server it connects through `scripts/mcp_hub_fixture_server.py`, after 40/40 checks on each desktop run and 39/39 at 390x844, beside `before-uiv2-21/`, the same eleven states served from origin/main at 16320ab and captured by this same walk in `--capture-only` (8/39 there: the tabs, the cards, the search and the counts do not exist yet, which is what the before set is). Opened and read: the 1440x900-dark catalog capture (three columns of named cards, each with Remote-HTTP, its trust word, its key requirement and its policy, and the tab strip above them), the 1440x900-dark activity capture (two servers carrying their stored sync note in rose, one local server reading `4 of 4 tools on`, and four test calls with their latency and outcome), the 390x844-light connected capture (full-bleed, one field per row, the tab strip still one line), and the before-uiv2-21 1440x900-dark catalog capture (chips that name no transport, the whole form open, and the playground clipped below the fold).
sets.theme_claim: light and dark, desktop 1280-1640 and narrow 390

sets.note: The MCP tool browser and its test call: fifteen shots on each of four viewports x light/dark (an empty Tools tab that names the next action, four rows each carrying a risk pill, its allowlist state, what a call does, what happens when a model asks and the arguments it takes, the filter chips with their counts, search narrowed to one tool, a search with no hit offering to clear itself, a write selected with its consent row and a disabled Test Call, arguments that are not JSON with the alert naming them, a call held in flight reading 'Calling...', the result inspector with its authorization line and a shut Raw response, a 3625-character output truncated with 'Show all', a Denied row with no test call, a switched-off server refused with the switch to move, the same call recovered, a tool that reports failure, and the keyboard path), written by `scripts/mcp_tools_walk.mjs` against a fixture it starts itself and the real stdio MCP server it syncs through the guide, after 56/56 checks on the six desktop runs and 55/55 on the two phone runs, beside `before-uiv2-23/`, the same states served from 57ef410 and captured by this same walk in `--capture-only`. Opened and read: the 1640x900-dark list capture (four rows, the risk words Read-only / Destructive / Write, the three labelled statements each, and the counters reading 1 configured - 4 discovered - 4 available - 0 denied), the 390x844-light consent capture (one column, the consent naming slow_echo and the write it is, Test Call greyed until it is ticked), the 1440x900-dark result capture (the Write pill, 1660 ms, 59 characters, 'Authorized as operator_one_call under standard - you confirmed this write', and the Raw response disclosure shut), the 1440x900-dark long capture (the truncation line with its hidden count and 'Show all 3631 characters'), and the before-uiv2-23 1640x900-dark list capture (three tabs, the tool list still a collapsed drawer on the Connected row, and a one-line output box with no risk and no consent).
sets.theme_claim: light and dark, desktop 1280-1640 and narrow 390

sets.note: The MCP guided connect wizard: thirteen shots on each of four viewports x light/dark (an empty step 1, the credentials step with a password-field token, the policy step with its consequence in words, the review of the seven things that will be saved, the consent row naming a local command, a save held in flight reading 'Saving and testing...', the green 'Connected - 4 tools discovered.' confirmation, the server list after it, a failed connection test that keeps the server's own note, the same server recovered in place, a stored token kept through a blank field, the keyboard path and a 315-character target at phone width), written by `scripts/mcp_wizard_walk.mjs` against a fixture it starts itself and the real stdio MCP server it connects to through step 4, after 38/38 checks on all eight runs, beside `before-uiv2-22/`, the same thirteen states served from b06ab96 and captured by this same walk in `--capture-only` (12/38 there: there are no steps, no consent and no result where the button is, which is what the before set is). Opened and read: the 1440x900-dark step-1 capture (four rail items with the first marked, 'Step 1 of 4 - Server' announced, Back disabled, Continue the only way on), the 1440x900-dark review capture (seven labelled rows including 'Credential: A new token will be stored, and only its mask shown', the advanced disclosure shut and out of the way), the 1440x900-dark consent capture (the exact command inside the consent sentence, the note that the screen cannot grant STUDIO_ALLOW_MCP_STDIO, and Continue refusing in amber), the 1440x900-dark success capture (the green result line, the namespace the tools arrive under, and the server row masked as Token sk-u...4b71), the 390x844-dark review capture (values wrapping in place, no sideways scroll), the 1440x900-light review capture (the same rows in the light theme, the focus ring on the step heading reading as a ring and not as a field), and the before-uiv2-22 1440x900-dark credentials capture (one form with alias, name, transport, policy, URL, auth header, token and raw headers JSON on screen at once above a 'Save & Sync Tools' button).

sets.note: The artifact list distinguishes what the run produced from what it only named.
The pipeline's recovery states, each with a way forward rather than a retry that would fail the same way.

Hover, press and focus-ring parity across the 51 control kinds, in both themes and at 360x740. Opened the dark at-rest capture: a loaded runtime in the inspector with its Unload action ringed, the Chat empty state centred, nothing clipped at 1440x900. The hover and press counts are the walk's, not this frame's.

The one status component in its four kinds, so a recovery is never drawn as a success. The error capture says `Could not read the preflight`, gives `Failed to fetch` as the cause, says what was kept, and offers Re-check and Providers — none of which reads as a success.
The three breakpoints with the rail collapsed and the inspector stacked; no horizontal scrollbar in any of them.

sets.story: UIUX-P0-01 (published set, re-shot by UIUX-P6-03, re-shot again by UIV2-04, re-shot again by UIV2-05)
sets.note: Re-shot on this tree: the set the README shows was twenty-two stories old and showed a Compare pane without the P5-03 criteria table or the P5-04 readiness strip, plus a horizontal overflow the later stories fixed. Re-captured with `scripts/capture_screenshots.mjs`, `validate_screenshots.py` -> 6 of 6, and all six opened: every pane draws its own empty state with a cause and a next step, nothing is clipped at 1440x900, and the inspector fits. Re-shot once more for UIV2-04 (approved V2 palette in the m5-redesign-system token block): same six panes, same viewport and OS-default theme, only the colour tokens changed; opened again and the indigo accent, canvas, surface and border roles read as the approved north-star values in both themes (the light/dark after-sets live under uiv2-v2/after-uiv2-04). Re-shot once more for UIV2-05 (responsive shared shell: header pinned to one <=64px row at every width, tablist moved out of the header to a 200px rail at >=1280, a 64px icon rail at 800-1279 and a scrollable row under the header at <800, inspector a 320px column at >=1440 and a drawer below, skills/MCP strip collapsed to one row); same six panes, opened again - all six tabs reachable, no horizontal overflow, and the before/after sets plus measured shell metrics live under uiv2-v2/before-uiv2-05 and uiv2-v2/after-uiv2-05).
sets.theme_claim: light (the OS default the manifest records; no dark variant exists)

sets.note: The preflight checklist, the one marked next step, and the recent-work list with its honest `not run` rows.
Before/after of the status component replacing the per-pane banners.
The streaming states with the throughput and readiness strip the Compare pane now carries.
The same noun for the same thing across the six panes; the captures are the evidence for the copy change.
The token set photographed at compact density, light at 900px, and the narrow rail.

Twelve 6-pane sets (dark, light, narrow, and the focused variants, before and after) with an index.json each. They are checked by their own validator, `scripts/validate_uiux_interaction_polish_screenshots.py`, which knows the 390x844 variants the published validator does not; this review checks the same files' checksums, sizes, viewports and themes from the indexes rather than duplicating that script.

This story's own before/after: `before/` is the published set as it stood at cee9159 (extracted with `git show`, checksums recomputed, capture time taken from the index that set recorded for itself), `after-dark/` is the same six panes photographed again on this tree with `--emulate-theme dark`, which the published set never had.

The five Council states this story makes say something, 5 states x 4 viewports x light/dark, shot by `scripts/council_state_walk.mjs` against an authenticated demo app after it passed 19/19 on each of the eight runs; each shot scrolls to the element that reports the state rather than to whatever the pane happened to show. Opened and read: the 1440x900-dark lost-turn capture (notice naming Seat 1 · Staff Architect, the model and '4 characters ... none of them reached the transcript', with Ask this seat again / Read the session / Check readiness, and the partial voice card under a 'Stream ended · not saved' badge rather than a Streaming badge), the 1440x900-dark still-answering capture ('still answering', not a failure, with Read it now / Stop watching, on a live session row), the 1440x900-light reopened-session capture ('This session is open again', the pinned conclusion kept, in the light palette), and the 390x844-light closed-session capture (the 409 notice stacked in the single mobile column with Write a note to reopen / Read the conclusion / Start a new session). Every one names a state and a next action; none leaves a permanent 'Streaming...' card.
sets.theme_claim: light and dark, desktop 1280-1640 and narrow 390

sets.note: Two V2-program sets. `baseline/` is the running app at pinned HEAD 9a584a3, captured from a disposable git-archive copy via demo_tour.py --serve with scripts/capture_screenshots.mjs (six tabs x 1640x900/1440x900/1280x800/390x844 in light and dark) plus the MCP hub overlay opened through the real header select. Opened and read: the 1440x900-light start, harness, hall and compare panes (checklist-heavy Start, dense Harness composer, four council role cards, criteria-table Compare, persistent right telemetry rail in all of them), the 390x844-light chat pane (mobile single column, three-option persona picker), and the 1440x900-light MCP overlay (one 860px dialog holding presets, form, servers and test call). `reference/` is the encoded approved three-region reference rendered by scripts/uiux_v2_reference_capture.mjs from wireframe.html; opened: harness at 1440x900-light (four regions with annotated widths, telemetry as header popover) and harness at 390x844-light (single column, annotations hidden). The baseline set is current-state evidence; the reference set is the target approved by the user at the UIV2-03 gate. `after-uiv2-04/` is the running app re-shot at the UIV2-04 commit after the approved palette landed: six panes at 1440x900 light, 1440x900 dark and 390x844 light plus the MCP overlay at 1440x900 light, opened and read against `baseline/` — the indigo accent (#4F5FE8 light / #93A0FF dark), canvas, surface and border roles now match the approved tokens while layout is unchanged. `before-uiv2-05/` and `after-uiv2-05/` bracket the UIV2-05 shared-shell change: opened the 390x844-dark pair (header was 108px with the tabs wrapped inside it, now one 56px row with a tab row under it) and the 1280x800-dark pair plus `after-uiv2-05/1280x800-dark/harness-drawer-open.png` (inspector was a permanent 320px column, now a 320px drawer over a 1080px central pane); the measured numbers are in `uiv2-05-shell-metrics-before.json` / `uiv2-05-shell-metrics-after.json`. `before-uiv2-06/` and `after-uiv2-06/` bracket the UIV2-06 inspector change: opened the 1440x900-dark harness pair (permanent telemetry rail -> contextual inspector with Approvals/Changes/Verification/Resources tabs) and `after-uiv2-06/1440x900-light/harness-telemetry-popover.png` (header Telemetry popover holding all four telemetry cards incl. the model load/unload actions), plus the per-pane inspector tabs in the 1440x900-dark set (Council People/Evidence, Pipeline Stage/Artifacts, Compare Evaluation, Chat hidden by default). `before-uiv2-11/` and `after-uiv2-11/` bracket the UIV2-11 session-navigation change (served from disposable git-archive copies at a723078 and a6b578a, four seeded sessions, one flipped to running): opened the 1440x900-dark pair - before has no filter box and the running row's delete is an enabled one-click button, after has the named Filter sessions box, shown-of-total counts, the disabled (aria-disabled) delete on the running row, and the armed Confirm delete state with its irreversible-scope note - plus the walk state shots (filter-active, running-protected, armed-delete-scope, sessions-mobile at 390x844). `before-uiv2-12/` and `after-uiv2-12/` bracket the UIV2-12 pinned-conclusion scroll-lock fix (served from a disposable git-archive copy at b01704f vs the branch, one seeded closed Council session carrying a 17,430-char conclusion): opened the 1440x900-dark pair - before shows the conclusion flooding the whole pane as one unscrollable block with the transcript and composer pushed out of view, after shows it as a capped sticky card at the top of the transcript with Expand/Unpin/close controls while the transcript and composer stay visible - plus the walk state shots (pinned-long-conclusion, unpinned, resized, expanded-modal at 1440x900-dark; mobile-long-conclusion at 390x844-dark). `before-uiv2-13/` and `after-uiv2-13/` bracket the UIV2-13 clear-session change (served from a disposable git-archive copy at 65f6e94 vs the branch, seeded Council sessions): opened the 1440x900-dark pair - before has no clear control anywhere (sidebar rows carry no delete button, the composer row has only Run full round / Finish and pin summary, and DELETE /api/hall/sessions answers 405), after adds the armed per-row delete, the sidebar Clear all, and the composer Clear session button matching the wireframe's hall composer row - plus the walk state shots (armed-delete with its role=alert scope note, armed-clear-all, cleared-empty, populated-with-clear-controls at 1440x900-dark). `before-uiv2-14/` and `after-uiv2-14/` bracket the UIV2-14 session-list/roles/compact-conclusion change (served from a disposable git-archive copy of origin/main vs the branch, one seeded closed Council session with architect + critic replies and a 9k-char conclusion): opened the 1440x900-dark pair - before shows rows with only '3 voices • 3 msgs' (no participant roles) and a 24vh conclusion body flooding the pane, after shows wrapped role chips on each row (Human / Staff Architect / Adversarial Critic), a compact 96px pinned summary, the height-capped verdict block, and the composer visible again - plus the walk state shots (compact-conclusion-with-roles and full-conclusion-modal at 1440x900-dark; mobile-roles-compact at 390x844-dark).
